style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots and spec screens, warm light-grey studio backdrop #EDEDEB for info shots, soft beige board #F5F1E8 for detail shots
style.iconSystem: thin-line circular icon slots, single neutral color, kept empty unless copy is supplied
style.lightingSystem: soft neutral studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean minimal womenswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, warm light-grey backdrop #EDEDEB, soft beige board #F5F1E8, deep charcoal garment tone #1E1E1E, deep grey text #2D2D2D and one terracotta accent #C97B4A; soft neutral studio lighting with a front-left key and gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line circular icon style; clean high-end garment photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable front-facing and slight 3/4 hero presentation on natural wooden hangers; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable front-facing and slight 3/4 hero presentation with the garment on a wooden hanger; flat lay only for spec screens; consistent garment scale across the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless backdrop paper and smooth matte board, natural wooden hangers as the presentation anchor
